title: Calycosin attenuates severe acute pancreatitis-associated acute lung injury by curtailing high mobility group box 1 - induced inflammation.
authors: Zhu, Chang-Ju; Yang, Wan-Guang; Li, De-Jian; Song, Yao-Dong; Chen, San-Yang; Wang, Qiao-Fang; Liu, Yan-Na; Zhang, Yan; Cheng, Bo; Wu, Zhong-Wei; Cui, Zong-Chao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药成分毛蕊异黄酮通过抑制HMGB1/NF-κB通路减轻重症胰腺炎相关肺损伤，分子对接仅作为辅助验证，核心为炎症机制与药效，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Acute lung injury (ALI) is a common and life-threatening complication of severe acute pancreatitis (SAP). There are currently limited effective treatment options for SAP and associated ALI. Calycosin (Cal), a bioactive constituent extracted from the medicinal herb Radix Astragali exhibits potent anti-inflammatory properties, but its effect on SAP and associated ALI has yet to be determined. AIM: To identify the roles of Cal in SAP-ALI and the underlying mechanism. METHODS: SAP was induced via two intraperitoneal injections of L-arg (4 g/kg) and Cal (25 or 50 mg/kg) were injected 1 h prior to the first L-arg challenge. Mice were sacrificed 72 h after the induction of SAP and associated ALI was examined histologically and biochemically. An in vitro model of lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced ALI was established using A549 cells. Immunofluorescence analysis and western blot were evaluated in cells. Molecular docking analyses were conducted to examine the interaction of Cal with HMGB1. RESULTS: Cal treatment substantially reduced the serum amylase levels and alleviated histopathological injury associated with SAP and ALI. Neutrophil infiltration and lung tissue levels of neutrophil mediator myeloperoxidase were reduced in line with protective effects of Cal against ALI in SAP. Cal treatment also attenuated the serum levels and mRNA expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines tumor necrosis factor-alpha, interleukin-6, IL-1beta, HMGB1 and chemokine (CXC motif) ligand 1 in lung tissue. Immunofluorescence and western blot analyses showed that Cal treatment markedly suppressed the expression of HMGB1 and phosphorylated nuclear factor-kappa B (NF-kappaB) p65 in lung tissues and an in vitro model of LPS-induced ALI in A549 cells suggesting a role for HGMB1 in the pathogenesis of ALI. Furthermore, molecular docking analysis provided evidence for the direct interaction of Cal with HGMB1. CONCLUSION: Cal protects mice against L-arg-induced SAP and associated ALI by attenuating local and systemic neutrophil infiltration and inflammatory response via inhibition of HGMB1 and the NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 背景：急性肺损伤（ALI）是重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）常见且危及生命的并发症。目前针对SAP及其相关ALI的有效治疗选择有限。毛蕊异黄酮（Cal）是从药用植物黄芪中提取的一种生物活性成分，具有强效抗炎特性，但其对SAP及相关ALI的作用尚未确定。目的：明确Cal在SAP-ALI中的作用及其潜在机制。方法：通过两次腹腔注射L-精氨酸（4 g/kg）诱导SAP，并在首次L-精氨酸攻击前1小时注射Cal（25或50 mg/kg）。在SAP诱导后72小时处死小鼠，并通过组织学和生化方法检查相关ALI。使用A549细胞建立脂多糖（LPS）诱导的ALI体外模型。对细胞进行免疫荧光分析和蛋白质印迹检测。进行分子对接分析以检查Cal与HMGB1的相互作用。结果：Cal治疗显著降低血清淀粉酶水平，并减轻与SAP和ALI相关的组织病理学损伤。中性粒细胞浸润和肺组织中中性粒细胞介质髓过氧化物酶水平降低，与Cal对SAP中ALI的保护作用一致。Cal治疗还降低了肺组织中促炎细胞因子肿瘤坏死因子-α、白细胞介素-6、IL-1β、HMGB1和趋化因子（CXC基序）配体1的血清水平及mRNA表达。免疫荧光和蛋白质印迹分析显示，Cal治疗显著抑制肺组织和LPS诱导的ALI体外模型A549细胞中HMGB1及磷酸化核因子-κB（NF-kappaB）p65的表达，提示HGMB1在ALI发病机制中的作用。此外，分子对接分析提供了Cal与HGMB1直接相互作用的证据。结论：Cal通过抑制HGMB1和NF-kappaB信号通路，减轻局部和全身中性粒细胞浸润及炎症反应，从而保护小鼠免受L-精氨酸诱导的SAP及相关ALI的影响。
